steps: TIME-CRITICAL - activate stroke pathway, non-contrast CT immediately.
IV thrombolysis (alteplase/tenecteplase) if within window and no contraindication.
Mechanical thrombectomy for large-vessel occlusion up to 24 h in selected patients.
Aspirin 300 mg once haemorrhage excluded (delay 24 h after thrombolysis).
Admit to stroke unit; permissive hypertension, glucose/temperature control, swallow screen, early secondary prevention.

confirm: Sudden focal neurological deficit; non-contrast CT to exclude haemorrhage, then confirm ischaemia. Establish last-known-well time.
